Flatten Suite Predictions to One Row per Plot

Source: R/suite.R
as.data.frame.resolve_suite_predictions.Rd

The RESOLVE engine's prediction table, the columns resolve predict --suite writes: plot_id, then per target the prediction (<target>; for a vote also <target>_code and <target>_agreement; for a spherical mean <target>_latitude and <target>_longitude), its dispersion (<target>_sd for a mean, <target>_circular_sd for a bearing, <target>_spread_km for a spherical mean), the four recognition columns, and, when present, <target>_seed<N> for each member (<target>_seed<N>_latitude and _longitude for a spherical mean); a gap-fitted target adds <target>_fitted (<target>_fitted_latitude / _fitted_longitude) and <target>_fit_method, and a target with recorded values but no gap fit <target>_recorded (logical) there instead; a terrain-corrected target <target>_terrain, <target>_terrain_w_resolve, _w_dem, _w_dem_1km, <target>_dem and <target>_dem_1km.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'resolve_suite_predictions'
as.data.frame(
  x,
  row.names = NULL,
  optional = FALSE,
  probabilities = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A resolve_suite_predictions object from resolve.predict.suite().

row.names, optional

Ignored; present for the generic's signature.

probabilities

Also include each vote target's class probabilities, <target>_prob_<class> (default FALSE).

...

Unused.

Value

A data.frame with one row per plot.
